name: RepointQR
summary: Editable dynamic QR codes for print: change the destination after printing, with a free plan, scan counts and PNG, SVG and PDF export.
best_for: Small businesses and local campaigns that print QR codes on menus, flyers, posters or packaging and want to change the destination later without reprinting
skip_if: you only need a static QR code that never changes, you need a full QR and digital business card suite for a large team, you cannot accept a vendor redirect page on free codes, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Free codes send scans through a RepointQR branded redirect page, and removing it on Starter covers only up to 100 codes. The unlimited scans on the plan cards are subject to fair-use and rate controls in the terms. We could not read annual prices on the page. We have not used RepointQR ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: QR Starter · per month, Free $0 forever
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on repointqr.com/en/pricing, US dollars a month) RepointQR makes editable dynamic QR codes. Free costs $0 forever with unlimited dynamic codes and scans, editable destinations, PNG, SVG and PDF export and a RepointQR branded redirect page. QR Starter is $9.99 per month and gives premium features on up to 100 codes: no branded redirect, advanced analytics, password protection, expiry, scan alerts and UTM tracking. QR Pro is $29 per month, with all codes ad-free, advanced analytics and up to 3 teams of 5 people. The page has a Monthly and Annual toggle; we read only the monthly prices. The refund policy allows a request within 7 days of the first paid charge. We have not paid for a plan.
